pow.name: Proof of Work (SHA-256)
pow.notes: Fixed difficulty target for consistent workload across instances

pos.name: Proof of Stake (Signature Verification)
pos.notes: Pre-generated test messages and signatures for consistency

bft.name: Byzantine Fault Tolerance (PBFT)
bft.notes: Simulated PBFT consensus with fixed node count and message sizes

zk.name: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZK-SNARK)
zk.notes: Simple arithmetic circuit for proof generation

zk_cloudzk.name: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZK-SNARK) with Cloud-ZK FPGA
zk_cloudzk.notes: Uses Cloud-ZK toolkit for BLS12-377 MSM acceleration on FPGA. Requires Cloud-ZK AFI loaded on F1 instances.

pow_gpu.name: Proof of Work (SHA-256) GPU-Accelerated
pow_gpu.notes: GPU-optimized SHA-256 mining using PyCUDA/CuPy for parallel computation. Requires NVIDIA GPU and CUDA. Falls back to CPU if GPU unavailable.
